capabilities.name: Repository Structural Inventory
capabilities.responsibility: Derive deterministic structural evidence about Python modules, symbols, imports, reverse imports, static entrypoint/test reachability, source hashes, dynamic-import flags, and per-capability implementation fingerprints for capability preflight and drift review.
capabilities.authority_role: Structural evidence provider only; it does not decide capability lifecycle, semantic authority, reuse policy, or whether NEW is authorized.
safety_invariants: Repository inventory is machine-derived and must not become a hand-maintained semantic authority.
Static reachability and docstrings are evidence signals only and never prove runtime or architectural authority.
Capability fingerprints are derived from catalog ownership_paths and may signal implementation change but may not independently authorize or reject architecture changes.
Structural evidence may improve preflight recall, but preflight must continue to return new_authorized=false.
capabilities.notes: Layer 1 of the Capability Control Plane. Reuses the existing scanner for path-claim enforcement and the existing preflight scorer for semantic retrieval rather than creating parallel control systems.
